rows.note: Use this for statistical figures or collected numerical data, especially in reports and surveys.

example.english: The statistics in the report show that young people are spending more and more time online.
example.traditional: 份報告入面嘅統計數字顯示，年輕人上網嘅時間越嚟越長。

rows.note: Use this for the academic discipline of statistics rather than for the figures themselves.

example.english: I’m studying statistics, so I have to do data analysis all the time.
example.traditional: 我讀緊統計學，成日都要做數據分析。
